title: UnitGrounded
description: A unit's home base could not pay its upkeep at an economy window (CONTRACTS §6; ECONOMY EC-4, EC-6; NX-412 part 2): the unit is grounded, never deleted. It drops its job claim and order, returns to its home and stays there (an aircraft landed, a ground unit parked), takes no new job or order, and still returns fire. Once per change, not per window. Only for a side not in unlimited mode (EC-15). Public view: the coalition sees its own units (a feed line, GAMEPLAY §1a); ENEMY dropped (proposed).
